ZMB.note: The MOU is for AI e-government services across ministries; no sector AI tool is piloted or in service.
Only a joint feasibility study for a national AI data centre; no data centre for hire in service is stated.
The government CTO's remark on data sovereignty is a statement, not a strategy, draft rule, rule, hosting or contract term.
Only a programme is named, not a national digital strategy; its $100 million fibre and ID commitment is a programme fact.
The MOU to enable AI-powered e-government services across 25 ministries is a plan; no service is stated online.

facts.fact: Government chief technology officer Kasali Musenge said dependence on external technical expertise is a digital sovereignty risk to be mitigated urgently, and ITWeb reports officials signalled a strong need to reduce dependence on foreign technical expertise.

ZMB.note: No nationally owned data centre for hire is described.
